name: Hypercord
note: metadata only: the plugin manager reads this, never plugin code

themes.note: CSS only: a theme is text injected at one point and can never execute
themes.injection: one <style> element (id hypercord-theme), replaced whole by src/preload.cjs

sources.description: a .theme.css file installed into the user's themes folder, read only while enabled
a theme fetched once, at the moment it is installed, then read from disk - never on a timer
one quick-CSS string edited in the manager window

refuses: an @import that is not an allow-listed https url
